direct_bypass_probe.explanation: v0.1 runs the monitor in the same process and uid as the code it mediates. Non-mediated writes are possible; they are detected on the next mediated request (STATE_INCONSISTENT) but not prevented.

notes: Counts are finite observations under this profile and attack corpus; they are not proof of zero future risk.
